text: Or, Say, what is thy mind, and I will doe, &c. , Heb. speaketh, or thinketh.
Heb. searched. , Heb. vncouer thine eare.
Or, by his loue towards him.
Or, diligently. Heb. greatly. , Heb. in the day of the businesse. , Or, that sheweth the way.
Or, thou peruerse rebell. Heb. sonne of peruerse rebellion.
Heb. is the sonne of death.
Heb. instruments. , Hebr. that was his.
Or, The Lord be witnesse of that which, &c.
